MAYA LIN
Seattle, WA | maya.lin@email.example | linkedin.com/in/mayalin-dev | github.com/mayalin

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Dedicated Senior Android Engineer with 7.5 years of experience designing and shipping high-performance mobile applications used by over 5 million daily active users. Expert in modern Android development with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, and reactive architectures. Strong proponent of clean architecture, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

EXPERIENCE

Senior Android Engineer | FinTech Innovations, Seattle, WA | June 2020 – Present (4.2 years)
- Led migration of flagship banking app from XML layouts to 100% Jetpack Compose, reducing UI codebase by 38% and UI crash rate by 45%.
- Architected asynchronous event-driven pipelines using Kotlin Coroutines and StateFlow, improving screen transition latency by 120ms.
- Implemented dependency injection using Dagger Hilt across 16 modular feature modules.
- Built offline-first transactional caching using Room database and Retrofit with custom OkHttp interceptors.
- Authored comprehensive test suites with JUnit 5, MockK, and Compose UI tests achieving 84% code coverage.
- Maintained GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows automating static analysis (Detekt, Android Lint) and Google Play internal track deployments.

Android Software Engineer | MobilePulse Corp, Bellevue, WA | January 2017 – May 2020 (3.3 years)
- Developed core audio streaming features using Android SDK, Kotlin, and Java for an entertainment app with 10M+ downloads.
- Refactored legacy MVP codebase to MVVM and Clean Architecture patterns.
- Integrated RESTful APIs with Retrofit and Moshi, ensuring robust error handling and token refresh lifecycles.
- Managed Gradle multi-module build optimization, cutting clean build times by 30%.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
University of Washington, Seattle, WA | Graduated May 2017

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Languages: Kotlin, Java
- Android Technologies: Android SDK, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Flow, Dagger Hilt, Room, Retrofit, Navigation Component
- Architecture: Clean Architecture, MVVM, MVI, Multi-Module Design
- Testing & Tools: JUnit, MockK, Espresso, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Gradle, Git

MARCUS VANCE
Chicago, IL | marcus.vance@email.example | github.com/marcusvance | (312) 555-0192

- Governed containerized workloads across 40+ Kubernetes clusters on AWS using Terraform for declarative infrastructure as code.

Lead Software Engineer | FinTech Systems, Chicago, IL | August 2014 – February 2019 (4.5 years)

- Implemented database sharding strategies on PostgreSQL databases to overcome vertical scaling limitations.
- Built comprehensive telemetry and tracing infrastructure using OpenTelemetry and Prometheus.

Backend Software Engineer | Enterprise Core, Indianapolis, IN | June 2012 – July 2014 (2.0 years)
- Developed core transaction processing services in Java EE, Hibernate, and Oracle SQL.
- Built RESTful web services and automated integration testing pipelines.

EDUCATION
- Master of Science in Computer Science | Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta, GA | 2014
- Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering | Purdue University, West Lafayette, IN | 2012

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Languages: Java, Kotlin, SQL, Bash
- Frameworks & Systems: Spring Boot, Microservices, Distributed Systems, Kafka, gRPC, Hibernate
- Data & Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis, Oracle DB
- Cloud & DevOps: Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Terraform, System Design, Prometheus
